decisions.reason: Who bribes the harbourmaster is a separate question from who runs the smuggling.
What the debt to Mara costs Seraphine is a concrete question that grew out of her debts.
Finding the ledger is what earns Mara her pay.
Mara followed the map to the cove it marks and found it.
The chart has not come up since the docks, so it is done with.
Mara put the ring back in Winifred's hand, as she swore.
The fifth of May has passed, so Seraphine must have given the berth.
